title: Mirabel and the Deadline
author: Hazel Vasquez
blurb: Ada Zhou, a whistle-blower living under four names, works cases no one wants attributed. Then a dead handler sends a meeting invitation for tomorrow — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must extract a defector who may be the bait before the border checkpoint shifts change.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
